job_attempts_outcome_check.name: job_attempts_outcome_check
job_attempts_outcome_check.value: outcome is null or outcome in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'lease_expired', 'cancelled', 'unknown')

outbox_events_lease_expiry_idx.name: outbox_events_lease_expiry_idx
outbox_events_lease_expiry_idx.where: lease_owner is not null and status = 'pending'

invitations_pending_email_key.name: invitations_pending_email_key
invitations_pending_email_key.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

document_parties_one_target_check.name: document_parties_one_target_check
document_parties_one_target_check.value: not (contact_id is not null and company_id is not null)

document_tags_tag_check.name: document_tags_tag_check
document_tags_tag_check.value: tag = lower(btrim(tag)) and length(tag) between 1 and 40

notebook_automations_due_idx.name: notebook_automations_due_idx
notebook_automations_due_idx.where: archived_at is null and enabled is true

sources_workspace_url_hash_key.name: sources_workspace_url_hash_key
sources_workspace_url_hash_key.where: url is not null and content_hash is not null

task_dependencies_target_check.name: task_dependencies_target_check
task_dependencies_target_check.value:
(kind = 'waiting_on' and depends_on_task_id is null and waiting_on_id is not null)
        or (kind <> 'waiting_on' and depends_on_task_id is not null and depends_on_task_id <> task_id)

tasks_parent_not_self_check.name: tasks_parent_not_self_check
tasks_parent_not_self_check.value: parent_task_id is null or parent_task_id <> id
